intro.title: print() writes to the screen
intro.body: print() takes whatever is inside the parentheses and shows it. Text goes in quotes; numbers do not.

options.text: ready then 3 on the next line

challenges.explanation: Each print() call writes its value and then moves to a new line.

challenges.prompt: Decide whether the statement about this code is true.
challenges.statement: This code prints the word Hello without quotation marks.
challenges.explanation: Quotes mark the text in code; they are not printed.

challenges.prompt: Complete the line so it prints Hi!
challenges.explanation: Text must be wrapped in quotes, so print("Hi!") is correct.

challenges.prompt: Tap the broken line, then pick the fix.
challenges.explanation: Quotes around name make it literal text. Joining with + inserts the variable's value.

challenges.prompt: Put the lines in order so the program prints a greeting, then the score.
challenges.explanation: Programs run top to bottom, so the greeting comes first.
